$comment: What any good explanation of this PR says, written by a model from the PR's title, description and diff only (scripts/eval-assertions.ts). The eval grades each run against them. Delete one that is wrong; keep them stable so evals compare.

assertions.text: Says that blocking loader placeholders for syncing accounts were replaced by small non-blocking sync indicators, so existing, possibly slightly outdated data is shown immediately.
Says that the old blocking pattern looked like a stuck loader when queues were slow or a family had many accounts, which motivated the change.
Says that Sync updates new family timestamps (latest sync activity and latest sync completed) which serve as inputs to cache keys, delegating cache busting to the background sync.
Says that BalanceSheet::AccountTotals caches the account groups query with currency conversion and only refetches when a sync completes and changes balance data.
Says that BalanceSheet::SyncStatusMonitor caches the set of syncing account ids, invalidated on sync events, avoiding an is-syncing query on every page load.
Says that BalanceSheet was split into smaller classes and value objects such as ClassificationGroup and AccountGroup, which hold totals, weights and syncing state.
Says that sparkline endpoints now use HTTP conditional GET (ETag/last-modified, 304) keyed on the family's last completed sync.
Does not claim that the sync indicators still hide or replace balances and charts while an account is syncing.
Does not claim that syncing status is still computed by a database query on every page load or invalidated by entry updates.
names the cached account totals class
names the sync status monitor class
